newsitem.title: FINLAND: OKOBANK REORGANISES TREASURY, CAPITAL MKTS. [CORRECTED 14:05 GMT]
newsitem.headline: OKOBANK REORGANISES TREASURY, CAPITAL MKTS. [CORRECTED 14:05 GMT]

text.p: Finnish cooperative-controlled bank OKOBANK said in a statement on Monday it had reorganised its treasury and capital markets division.
It announced the following appointments effective on September 15:

- Assistant director Timo Ritakallio was appointed as head of the new capital markets department. The department will be part of the treasury and capital markets division, headed by executive director Mikael Silvennoinen.
- Manager Jorma Alanne was appointed as new head of treasury.
- Jyrki Knuutinen was appointed as new issues manager.
- Senior manager Antti Heinonen was appointed as head of international money markets and he continues as head of the foreign exchange unit as well (Corrects appointment).
- Manager Matti Hannuksela was appointed as head of the domestic money and capital markets.
